name: bulgarian jump squat
description: A single-leg squat jump with the rear foot elevated, building explosive power and balance in each leg.
instructions: Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Lower into a split squat until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up explosively through your front foot so it leaves the floor.
Land softly and sink straight back into the next rep.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.
